name: @gcu/gsjs
description: Modern pure-JS geostatistics for the browser — the evolving sibling to the frozen @gcu/gslib oracle. A neighbourhood-driven kriging engine (krige) exposing intermediate state (the BlockEstimateTensor: weights + sample indices + variance + status + QKNA diagnostics), plus realization, aggregation, cross-validation, declustering — validated bit-for-bit against GSLIB kt3d. WebGPU acceleration is roadmapped behind a backend seam.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia
